title: PyroGuard: An Intelligent Fire Fighting Robot for Rapid Emergency Response
summary: Developed PyroGuard, an intelligent firefighting robot aimed at improving emergency response through rapid fire detection, autonomous navigation, and targeted fire suppression. title: Interfacing HC-05 Bluetooth Module for Home Automation Using Arduino UNO microcontroller
summary:
The HC-05 Bluetooth module typically operates within a range of about 33 feet, although factors like obstacles and electromagnetic interference can reduce this distance. It uses a serial communication interface compatible with UART, allowing for reliable data transmission and reception. The module's settings, including device name, operating mode, and communication parameters, can be configured using AT commands. It functions on a DC voltage between 3.6V and 6V and features an integrated antenna, enhancing the efficiency and stability of its wireless communication.

Interfacing the HC-05 Bluetooth module with an Arduino Uno R3 enables wireless control of home automation devices through Bluetooth communication. The HC-05 can function in either master or slave mode and pairs with smartphones or other Bluetooth-enabled devices. It communicates with the Arduino via serial communication using the TX and RX pins. In a home automation system, the Arduino receives commands from the connected Bluetooth device through the HC-05, processes the data, and controls appliances such as lights, fans, or security systems. This setup provides a simple, cost-effective solution for building a smartphone controlled wireless home automation system.

title: Electrical Service Design
summary:
Electrical service design is a critical component in the planning and construction of modern residential buildings, as it ensures safe, reliable, and efficient distribution of electrical power and communication services. A well-designed electrical system must meet the growing demand for electrical energy while complying with national codes, safety standards, and sustainability considerations. In Bangladesh, the Bangladesh National Building Code (BNBC 2020) provides comprehensive guidelines for electrical installations to ensure occupant safety, system reliability, and regulatory compliance. This work focuses on the complete electrical service design of a modern apartment building, integrating both power and communication systems. The design includes conduit layout, fixture layout, communication layout, lightning protection system, and an 11 kV substation single line diagram, along with a detailed Bill of Quantities (BOQ). Through this assignment, theoretical knowledge of electrical engineering is applied to a realistic building scenario, emphasizing practical design decisions, load management, protection coordination, grounding, and cost estimation. The work aims to develop a holistic understanding of building electrical systems while maintaining compliance with BNBC 
2020 and relevant international standards.
